WHAT WENT INTO IT

The model and its limits

What is working

  • XGBoost estimates lap time from past pace, tyre state, position and measured weather.
  • Both pit choices are projected over the same remaining race distance.
  • Where two historical checkpoints pass the input checks, you can inspect the update one lap later.

What is still research

  • Rain, Safety Cars and traffic gaps are not modeled as changing scenario events here.
  • The complete lap-by-lap replay and unseen-race strategy evaluation are not finished.
  • The alternative strategy was not observed in history; its outcome is simulated.
